name: 77099 · Houston, TX
findings: ZIP 77099 (Houston) has 106 nonprofit organizations. 33 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 28 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (57% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77099 (Houston) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
